==Summary==
:{{pov|[[Nynaeve al'Meara]]}}

[[Nynaeve al'Meara|Nynaeve]] thinks she sees [[Rand]], but when she tries to get a better look, a cart moves between them. Nynaeve laments the high prices despite the low quality of meat. The mood of the people concerns her. In the [[Two Rivers]], people picked themselves back up, instead of spending their days sulking. Nynaeve is frustrated that [[Egwene al'Vere|Egwene]] still objects to almost every suggestion she makes. At least she convinced Egwene to stop using the [[Twisted stone ring|dream ring]] at night since the Black Ajah were in ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod|Tel'aran'rhoid]]''. Thinking about the [[Black Ajah]] and [[Aes Sedai]] reminds her of how much she hates [[Moiraine]]. [[Juilin]] finds Nynaeve and says the women she seeks are guests of the High Lord [[Samon]]. Juilin is very nervous and shifty. They walk back to Mother [[Ailhuin Guenna|Guenna]]'s house.

Nynaeve walks into the house and realizes it is a trap when she sees Guenna sitting in a chair unable to move. [[Liandrin]] walks into the room. Nynaeve tries to channel but finds herself [[Shielding|shielded]], so she punches Liandrin and [[Rianna Andomeran]], trying to run out of range of the shielding. Liandrin and her companion use [[Five Powers|Air]] to beat Nynaeve. Liandrin says Nynaeve fought almost as fiercely as Egwene who was punished with Air too. Rianna is about to kill Guenna but Liandrin allows her to live in exchange for her silence, saying that Rianna kills too quickly when people can be used. Liandrin used [[Compulsion]] to make Juilin bring them to Nynaeve. Liandrin puts Nynaeve into her coach along with [[Elayne]] and Egwene to take her to her master, the High Lord Samon. Egwene is unconscious and badly bruised. Liandrin says they are bait, part of the plan laid by the Forsaken [[Be'lal]]. Nynaeve and Elayne try to bluff Liandrin into believing that they themselves are bait to capture the Black Ajah, but it has no apparent effect. Liandrin says only that after they are used as bait, they will be interrogated and then thirteen [[Myrddraal]] will be used to [[Turning|turn]] them to the [[Shadow]].
